subject: Acceptance & signoff lanes — timeline and MSA/DPA sequencing
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@healthline.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@healthline.com>
Date: 2025-09-17 09:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for pilot acceptance and legal docs

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement asked me to confirm a few items so they can schedule approvals next week:

- Final MSA + DPA redlines (we prefer consolidated redlines, not inline).
- A clear acceptance checklist tied to the pilot success criteria (performance SLA targets, retention limits, and exportability).
- Expected order form amount and billing cadence for the pilot period (we'll need this for our PO).

Can you share an ownership map showing who at Redwood will sign off on each acceptance gate (security, legal, billing)? Also, is there a hard dependency between MSA signature and enabling pilot billing, or can you start provisioning once the DPA is in place?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — procurement is trying to lock the committee calendar.

Best,
Emily
Emily Chen
Head of Vendor Ops, HealthLine Medical
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@healthline.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-17 11:02 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for pilot acceptance and legal docs

Emily,

Thanks — quick answers below and attaching a draft acceptance checklist and our consolidated redlines for the MSA/DPA. See attached: HealthLine_MSADPA_v0.3_redlines.pdf and procurement-acceptance-checklist.xlsx.

Short answers:
- We can provision sandbox capacity and shared telemetry once the DPA is executed (covers data handling). MSA signature is required to enable production billing and any long-lived reserved capacity.
- Signoff ownership: Security (Redwood: Karthik Iyer), Legal (Redwood: Kimberly Park / your legal counsel), Procurement/Billing (Redwood: Laura Bennett).
- Recommended close timeline: 2 weeks for legal review + 1 week for procurement PO and bookkeeping if redlines are limited to our standard exceptions. If you need an accelerated signoff we can support a canary billing arrangement (start billing at test-rate) subject to PO receipt.

Can you confirm your procurement committee availability next Tue/Thu? If yes, we'll prioritize a condensed Q&A with our legal ops and Karthik on security gating.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Commercial Legal, Redwood Inference

Attachments: HealthLine_MSADPA_v0.3_redlines.pdf (PDF, 2 pages, redline summary), procurement-acceptance-checklist.xlsx (Excel, acceptance criteria + owners)
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@healthline.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurements Team <procurements@healthline.com>
Date: 2025-09-17 12:18 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for pilot acceptance and legal docs

Kimberly —

Tue morning works for procurement. Quick clarifying Qs for the checklist you attached:

1) Under 'Data Retention' you list a 30-day default cache window and option for customer-managed retention. We need explicit language on exportability (format and timeline) — can your team commit to JSONL export within 48 hours of a written request?
2) For SOC2 evidence, will you provide our security team with the standard SOC2 Type II summary report and supporting controls mapping?
3) On billing: procurement prefers billed-after-PO rather than canary billing. If MSA lag means provisioning is delayed, can you provide temporary trial credits to avoid blocking the pilot?

Looping in our counsel for legal redline comments: David Park (d.park@lawconsults.com).

Thanks — Emily
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@healthline.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-17 15:35 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for pilot acceptance and legal docs

Emily / team —

Quick answers from Security / Delivery POV:

- Exportability: we can commit to providing conversation exports in JSONL (schema attached in the checklist tab) within 48 hours of a written request. We'll include field-level annotations and timestamping to support auditability.
- SOC2: yes, we'll provide a SOC2 Type II summary + controls mapping for the production environment (sanitized for vendor distribution). For deeper assurance, we can schedule a security call and share our compliance playbook.
- Sandbox provisioning: we can turn on a sandbox workspace immediately after the DPA is signed and provide trial credits to cover the sandbox usage while PO completes. Production capacity (e.g., any Dedicated slots or reserved throughput) requires MSA sign-off for billing and SLA coverage.

I'll join Tue morning to walk procurement through the security gates and expectations.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Security & Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@healthline.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-18 16:22 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for pilot acceptance and legal docs

Emily —

Following up after the procurement sync this afternoon. Procurement confirmed they will review the consolidated redlines and the acceptance checklist during Tuesday's committee and will aim to issue a PO within 5 business days of signoff. Two quick operational notes from our side:

- PO & Billing: Please make the PO out to Redwood Inference, Inc. and include the deal id HL-2025-0917-01 in the reference field. Our billing team requires the PO to match the order form amount; if you need a placeholder number for committee approval we can provide a capped estimate.
- Trial credits: We will provision sandbox access and a temporary credit line to keep the pilot running while your PO is processed (credit application inline and requires basic billing contact info).
- Acceptance gates: we'll treat security & data privacy (DPA), performance acceptance (SLA), and exportability validation as the three distinct gates. We'll coordinate a short acceptance demo at the end of pilot week 2 to validate metrics.

I'll upload the final acceptance checklist (with the export schema and attachments) to the HubSpot deal after your procurement committee meets. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HL-2025-0917-01

Speak Tue —
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Onboarding, Redwood Inference
